# Cncf Lunar Dev Reviewer

Review Lunar.dev using its official documentation and repository in the Orchestration &amp; Management / API Gateway category. Lunar.dev’s mission is to enable optimization and control of  third-party API consumption in production environments. Lunar is a lightweight tool that empowers DevOps and engineering teams  to centralize consumption, gain insight and visibility into usage patterns and costs, and utilize out-of-the-box policies.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
